subject: E-Commerce
title: Retail Therapy Is Real
description: One-minute skill: Retail Therapy Is Real.

hook.text: 62% of shoppers say they buy things to cheer themselves up. It's not a joke—buying relieves stress temporarily.

buildup.text: Shopping activates the brain's reward center. The act of choosing and purchasing provides a sense of control.

discovery.text: Sadness reduces the sense of control. Buying restores it. That's why people shop when stressed or unhappy.

twist.text: The relief is temporary. 'Buyer's remorse' often follows, creating a cycle of buying and regretting.

climax.text: E-commerce makes retail therapy frictionless. One-click buying at 2 AM means impulse goes unchecked.

punchline.text: 62% buy to feel better. Shopping gives control, then buyer's remorse takes it.

quiz.question: Why does shopping temporarily relieve sadness?
options: The act of choosing and buying restores a sense of control
